Welcome to the official YouTube channel for Norton Healthcare, a leading not-for-profit health care system serving Louisville, Southern Indiana and the surrounding communities.

Here, you’ll find inspiring patient stories, expert health advice, wellness tips, medical innovations, behind-the-scenes moments and the people who make compassionate care possible every day.

From heart and vascular care, neuroscience and cancer treatment to women’s health, orthopedics, pediatrics and primary care, Norton Healthcare is committed to helping our community live healthier lives.

Subscribe for:
• Patient stories and real recovery journeys
• Health and wellness education
• Expert insights from Norton Healthcare providers
• Medical breakthroughs and innovative treatments
• Community events and hospital updates
• Tips for living healthier at every age

Learn more about our services, providers and locations at NortonHealthcare.com.
